name: HTR-PM demonstration plant, Shidaowan, China (CNNC/Huaneng/Tsinghua)
description: world's first high-temperature gas-cooled reactor pebble-bed module plant; two 105 MWe reactor modules; grid-connected December 2021, commercial operation from December 2023; 750 C core-outlet helium, 566 C steam

sources.note: CNNC: "the world's first High Temperature gas cooled Reactor of Pebble bed Module (HTR-PM) is now connected to the grid"; core-outlet 750 C / steam 566 C from world-energy.org, 24 Aug 2021 (fuel loading); commercial operation Dec 2023 widely reported; read 2026-10-28
